utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Oren, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend? I can bring tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive! Yes, I’m still in; and thanks, bringing tools would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—what tools should I bring, and what time are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Jules, I heard the repair drive’s getting some good momentum. I’m heading out for errands, so I’ll swing by and see what else they need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Ira—thanks for checking in. I’ll let you know if anything specific comes up before you head over.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out and drop by afterward.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Hana — if you need any tools for the repair drive, I’m happy to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’ll check what we actually need first, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just let me know, and I’ll have my toolbox ready.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I probably missed the latest update, but I can help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Noah — the drop-off is at the community center parking lot, and they’re especially asking for tool kits and spare batteries.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — tool kits and spare batteries. I’ll swing by the community center parking lot and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and a few volunteers already signed up. If you want, I can keep an ear out for what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Tess. I’m glad it’s getting some help—I may take you up on that if I can figure out what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll listen around and let you know if I hear what’s still on the list. In the meantime, I’m glad it’s coming together.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I need to know the timing and where we’re dropping things off first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re aiming for Saturday morning, and we’ll drop everything off at the community center on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday morning works for me, as long as we have a clear pickup time too. Maple Street is fine—I just want to make sure I can get there without any hiccups.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive, Tess—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Sam—could you bring a sturdy screwdriver set and maybe some gloves? If you’ve got time, you could also help sort the donated parts when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’ll bring the screwdriver set and gloves, and I can help sort the donated parts when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive locations sorted—just tell me where you need me to send you, and I’ll point you there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—send me to the busiest spot first and I’ll spread the word. If you’ve got a second location after that, I can swing by there too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Head to the community center first—it’s the busiest spot by far. After that, the corner market is your best second stop.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, great—there’s a repair drive? I can spread the word and invite a few folks right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be really helpful, Quinn. I can send you the details right after this.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—send them over and I’ll start inviting people right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little with the repair drive, but I need to keep things low-key right now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli — what kind of help can you give, and when would be best to keep it low-key?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help sort supplies or make a quiet call this afternoon. If we keep it simple and don’t bring attention to it, that would be best.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Sam — I’ve got the repair drive lined up and I’m keeping things organized. Tell me what you’d like to tackle first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — I can start with sorting the tools and checking what needs replacing first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam — that’ll help us get a clear list fast. I’ll set aside a space for you and note anything we should replace.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you bring a Phillips screwdriver set and any spare zip ties you have? That would help us a lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring a Phillips screwdriver set and any spare zip ties I have.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs fixing and by when? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can check and get you the details, but I don’t have the list in front of me right now. I’ll swing by and let you know as soon as I hear what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira—just let me know when you’ve got the list, and I’ll help from there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, sorry I’m late — what’s left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries, Dane. I’ve got a clear list ready — we still need to sort the tools, check the donated parts, and set up the table by the curb.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can sort the tools and help check the donated parts right now.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can swing by after school pickup, if that helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be a huge help, Faye—thank you. I’ll set the tools aside for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks, Gus. I’ll come by right after pickup and grab the tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Noah — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Mara — I’m probably a bit behind on the details. What’s the best way I can help right now?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No problem — could you help by organizing the volunteer sign-up and checking which tools we still need? I can handle the rest once that’s sorted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve just been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive — what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I’ve only caught bits too, but I think they’re still gathering what needs fixing and who can help. I should probably check the notice again.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out too. If you see the notice again, let me know what it says.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira — I’m happy to help pull folks together for the repair drive. Want me to check who’s available and send out a quick update?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure — can you confirm who’s available first, then send the update?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll confirm who’s available first, then I’ll send the update once I have the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly tools and a few staples — screwdrivers, tape, nails, and any spare wood you’ve got. If you can bring labels too, I’ll sort everything out fast.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can bring screwdrivers, tape, nails, and some spare wood. I’ll also grab a few labels if I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, still on for today.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — what time should I swing by?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help however I can. What part of the repair drive needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — we could use help sorting supplies and checking which houses still need a visit. If you’re free, I’ll put you on the list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m free, and I can help with both of those. Put me on the list, and I’ll start sorting supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to drop by and help out. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting the drop-off list and labeling the spare parts, so the main thing is keeping everything organized. If you can help carry boxes, that would make a big difference.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I can do boxes — happy to help keep things organized too. Just point me to where you want me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and remind folks to bring tools. If you want, I can also ask a few neighbors to help out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks—I'm still hearing bits and pieces myself. If you can ask a few neighbors to help, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely—I’ll ask a few neighbors and keep reminding people to bring their tools.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies list for the repair drive—just tell me what you still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll send over the missing items once I check my notes. I’m probably running a bit late, but I’ll help cover whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, Dane — send the list when you can and I’ll keep track of what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and when do you need me there?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli — let’s keep it simple. I’m aiming for Saturday morning, and I’d love you there by 9 to help unload and sort.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday morning at 9 works for me. I’ll be there ready to unload and sort.
